title: Degree Bound for the Edmonds Determinant
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $A$ be a Boolean matrix indexed by $\text{Fin}(n)\times\text{Fin}(n)$. The total degree of the determinant of the Edmonds matrix specified by $A$ is at most $n$.
